prompt: Top-down aerial photograph of a long banquet hall floor, captured from directly overhead, showing exactly eight parallel buffet lines running side by side as eight neat horizontal rows of small dishes laid on warm cream linen runners. Each of the eight rows contains the same six positions of small dishes — but the dishes within each row are subtly different from the others: different garnishes, different sauces, different seasonings, different colors. The earthy palette runs across the whole grid — honey, amber, ochre, terracotta, dusty rose, umber, sage, cream. Warm wooden floor visible in the gaps between the eight linen runners. Soft warm overhead light, clean composition, photorealistic editorial photography, magazine quality, the visual rhythm of eight identical-but-varied rows is the subject.
